source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper uses balanced sign assignments and a mixed-strategy optimal design over a structured outcome class; Section 5 gives the PSD quadratic-class largest-eigenvalue form and describes the generally hard MSOD.
The paper develops minimax-variance a-priori balance, recovers blocking, pair matching, and rerandomization from structured outcome classes, and provides optimization-based designs.
The paper formulates a balance--robustness tradeoff for design-based treatment-effect precision and decomposes risk into predictable and residual outcome components.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Statistical Distributions and Applications 6:2, 2019, primary PDF
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For symmetric Bernoulli variables, an admissible correlation vector rho is characterized by (1-rho)/2 belonging to the CUT_n polytope.
The paper establishes precision optimality of a matched-pair design among stratified randomization schemes that treat each unit with probability one half.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Statistical Planning and Inference 219, 2022, published article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper optimizes a rerandomization threshold using observed and unobserved covariate considerations.
The preprint studies quadratic-form rerandomization and reports Euclidean distance as minimax-optimal within its stated precision comparison.
The preprint Gaussianizes assignments, optimizes over Gaussian covariance matrices, and supplies first-order local design-optimization algorithms rather than an exact balanced-sign-hull optimizer.
